name: AI Text Rewriter
description: AI-powered Chrome extension for text rewriting using OpenAI or OpenAI-compatible APIs. Professional writing assistant with 15 focused modes including Retone, custom prompts, and instant text transformation.

rewrite-retone.description: Retone text for superior context, clarity, tone & grammar (Ctrl+Shift+R)

rewrite-humanize.description: Rewrite selected text to be more human-like (Ctrl+Shift+H)

rewrite-professional.description: Rewrite selected text in professional tone (Ctrl+Shift+P)

rewrite-grammar.description: Fix grammar and spelling in selected text (Ctrl+Shift+G)
